reviewed_by: Claude Code, removing Butler's overdue goal check-in at the operator's request
reason: Live Core showed Butler opening a new recovery chat for every goal.progress_overdue event (about 120 a day) and most ended needs_attention because provider agents cannot take a message mid-turn. The operator asked to remove the overdue check-in. Core no longer schedules progress deadlines or emits goal.progress_overdue; review, recovery, authority and memory ignore already-queued overdue events; request_parent_status is no longer an effective action; the report tool drops next_checkpoint_at; the oversight view drops 'Next checkpoint due' and its authority copy now describes plan reassessment. Selected: the Butler oversight, authority, review, pivotal-memory and handoff-action suites (authority and handoff tests now use the plan-change trigger that still exists), the two Butler oversight frontend suites, and the real-Core Butler oversight journey at desktop and 390 px.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_universal_agent_tools.py references report_progress but 17 of its tests fail identically on unmodified origin/main locally, so it is not selected. The two PostgreSQL cases in tests/v3/test_handoff_butler_actions.py skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL; they passed locally against a disposable postgres:16 container. Broader auto-impact areas (core-api shards, interface layouts, other Butler settings areas) do not touch the changed oversight code.
